editorial.blurb: Hacienda Calavera is a visually stunning celebration destination where thoughtfully prepared Mexican and seafood dishes arrive fresh and perfectly seasoned, backed by genuinely attentive service.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit on a weekday to avoid parking challenges, and mention if you're celebrating—the team goes above and beyond with complimentary desserts and special touches like tequila shots and tableside photos.

topDishes.note: Smashable chocolate vessel filled with fruit, marshmallows & ice cream—so delicious diners keep eating despite being full
Grilled octopus with roasted potatoes and avocado—drives repeat visits
Porterhouse with edible gold, creamy mashed potatoes & asparagus—showstopper presentation
